tournaments.description: Family-friendly charity ice derby. Every ticket supports the Children's Hospital Foundation of Manitoba and CancerCare Manitoba Foundation; the derby has raised over $536,000 to date and 600 free rods are given away to kids.
tournaments.location: Selkirk Park on the Red River, Selkirk MB
tournaments.name: KidFish Ice Fishing Derby

tournaments.description: The 19th annual derby on the frozen Winnipeg River in Lac du Bonnet — thousands of dollars in cash and prizes, family activities, and food. A non-profit event that has invested over $294,000 back into the Lac du Bonnet community through grants, bursaries and donations.
tournaments.entry: Early bird (Nov 1–Feb 7): $65 adult, $30 youth, $190 family; regular: $85 adult, $35 youth, $240 family — see official site
tournaments.location: LdB Town Dock, Park Ave & Third St, Lac du Bonnet MB
tournaments.name: Lac du Bonnet Ice Fishing Derby

tournaments.description: The 22nd annual Winter Fish-Off — one of the biggest ice derbies in central Canada with a $20,000 grand prize and over $80,000 in guaranteed cash and prizes. A portion of proceeds supports the St.Amant Foundation (over $140,000 raised since 2014).
tournaments.location: West side of Falcon Lake, Whiteshell MB
tournaments.name: Falcon Lake Winter Fish-Off

tournaments.description: Annual two-day team walleye tournament on the Red River held each October during the greenback walleye migration, using a catch-photo-release format with teams scoring their heaviest five-fish bags each day. The 2026 edition (the 8th annual) ran Oct 17-18, 2026; no 2027 date has been published yet.
tournaments.name: Selkirk Walleye Championship
